notes.title: The Future of What
notes.content: Hello everyone! Unfortunately we will be putting [b]What Comes Next[/b] on hold for a couple of months while we're working on our next Big project. This is not an easy decision as we put a lot of hard work into What Comes Next! But we decided as a group to work on something new during our internship course, as we have some new members joining us. We will keep you updated on this and our current project in the future! Thank you for your support, Dandelion Developers!
